verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents locking a customer's account to block certain activity during an investigation or remediation. That is a first-party freeze/hold capability for suspicious activity. It does not cover the rest of the story: there is no evidence of configurable transaction or velocity limits per account or per program. The Card Auth Loop is only a developer building block for custom accept/reject logic and earns no credit, and no unlock or reinstatement process is documented. missing for 10: per-account and per-program transaction limits, velocity limits, program-level risk control configuration, documented reinstatement/unlock path, independent corroboration.
